strip_ansi_remove_ansi_escape_sequences: strip ANSI escape sequences from terminal output to prevent them from entering the model's context
strip_ansi_clean_subprocess_output: clean subprocess command output by removing CSI, OSC, DCS, and C1 control character sequences
strip_ansi_fast_path_no_escapes: fast-path check text for ESC or C1 bytes before running the full regex substitution
strip_ansi_handle_ecma48_sequences: handle the full ECMA-48 spec including private-mode CSI prefixes, colon-separated params, and intermediate bytes
strip_ansi_prevent_escape_leakage: prevent ANSI escape codes from leaking into model-generated file writes
